findings.title: Repeated ambiguity in acceptance criteria
findings.evidence: Three reviewed stories omit observable pass/fail outcomes; the pattern appeared in two successive audits.
findings.verification_method: Inspected three story records and compared with the acceptance-criteria checklist; recurrence IDs link two separate audits.
findings.as_of_context: Audit performed 2026-10-15; reviewed backlog state captured at audit time.
findings.impact_rationale: Missing pass/fail criteria prevent reliable acceptance decisions and weaken requirement-to-test traceability.

findings.title: One-off project-specific label mismatch
findings.evidence: One design label uses an obsolete requirement identifier.
findings.verification_method: Compared the design flow label directly with the current requirement identifier in the traceability index.
findings.as_of_context: Single design artifact reviewed during audit 2026-10-15.
findings.impact_rationale: The isolated stale label creates a limited traceability defect without demonstrated wider impact.
